Name: Colorful Fishing Rods
Description:
This mod does nothing on its own.

If you're a content modder, you can add a short snippet to your Content Patcher pack in order to set the color of a fishing rod while in use. This can be used to edit existing fishing rods, or to add color to custom fishing rods, which typically cannot be done without C#.

[code]        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "Mods/ColorfulFishingRods",
            "Entries": {
                "(T)IridiumRod": { //qualified ID of the rod from Data/Tools
                    //8-bit RGB
                    "R": 0,
                    "G": 255,
                    "B": 0,
                    "A": 255
                }
            }
        },
[/code]
See the optional files for an example.

[url=https://github.com/6480k/colorful-fishing-rods/tree/main]Source code[/url]﻿

Mod was written entirely by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/atravita/about-me?gameId=1303]atravita[/url]. I have full explicit permission to publish it.
100% of the donation points from this mod are given directly to the [url=https://www.againstmalaria.com/]Against Malaria Foundation[/url].
